# cor-table-header



<!-- Auto Generated Below -->


## Overview

Table header container — provides title, description, and actions slots above the table.
Purely presentational with slot-based content. Consumer decides which components to use.

## Properties

| Property     | Attribute     | Description                                                  | Type      | Default |
| ------------ | ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | --------- | ------- |
| `bottomLine` | `bottom-line` | Show bottom border line separating header from table content | `boolean` | `true`  |


## Slots

| Slot            | Description                                                          |
| --------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `"actions"`     | Right-side controls (buttons, inputs, filters)                       |
| `"description"` | Subtext below title (recommended: cor-typography variant="body-sm")  |
| `"title"`       | Main heading slot (recommended: cor-typography variant="heading-md") |
